answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 15941 Country: India Title: can the money of zakat present in the form of things, cloths, etc? Question: can the money of zakat present in the form of things, cloths, etc? Answer ID: 15941 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1455/1156/L=1430) Yes, it can be given and its market value will be considered as paid from total Zakah amount. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
